front-of-house.settings.shifts.window-be: Shifts start to count before the call time
How long before their call time people on a shift can use what the shift lets them do, such as scanning tickets. Changing this does not move shifts that already exist.
front-of-house.settings.shifts.window-af: Shifts keep counting after they end
How long after a shift ends people on it can still use what it lets them do. Someone leading the night can extend it if the show runs late. Changing this does not move shifts that already exist.
front-of-house.settings.shifts.sign-up-c: Close sign-up before the call time
How long before a shift's call time members can no longer sign up for it. A manager can still put someone on the shift.
front-of-house.settings.shifts.confirmat: Whether a sign-up is confirmed straight away or waits for a front-of-house manager to confirm it. Only a confirmed place lets someone work the night.
front-of-house.settings.shifts.release-n: Ask for cover when giving up a shift within

How close to the call time someone can no longer simply give up their place. Inside this time the place stays theirs until someone takes it as cover, and the front-of-house manager can see it needs covering.
First reminder before the call time
When the first reminder of a shift is sent. Set it to 0 to send no first reminder.
front-of-house.settings.reminders.second: Second reminder before the call time
When the second reminder of a shift is sent. Set it to 0 to send no second reminder. Someone who signs up late gets only one reminder.
front-of-house.settings.shifts.late-afte: Flag someone as not arrived after the call time
How long after their call time someone who has not checked in is flagged on the board, as a prompt to whoever is leading the night.
front-of-house.settings.checklists.block: Keep the house closed until checklists are done
When on, house open cannot be recorded while a checklist for before the show is unfinished. When off, the board warns instead.
front-of-house.settings.hours.count-from: Whether hours are counted from each shift's call time to its end, or from when someone checked in to when they checked out. Without both times, the shift's times are used.
front-of-house.settings.night-report.sig: Remind about unsigned night reports after
How long after a performance ends a night report that is still a draft is chased each morning.
front-of-house.settings.night-report.aut: Send signed night reports to those who read them
When on, people who may read night reports and follow them are sent the headline numbers and a link when a night is signed off. Incident details are never sent.
front-of-house.settings.incidents.review: Flag an incident nobody has opened after
How long a reported incident can wait before it is flagged as not yet reviewed.
front-of-house.settings.incidents.immedi: Tell reviewers at once about incidents at or above
Incidents at or above this severity are sent to reviewers straight away. Less serious ones arrive in a summary each morning.
front-of-house.settings.retention.assign: How long after a shift ends the record of who was on it is kept. Shortening this deletes older history at the next daily run.
front-of-house.settings.retention.checkl: How long checklists worked through on the night are kept. Shortening this deletes older ones at the next daily run.
front-of-house.settings.emergency.review: How long a venue's emergency card can go without being reviewed before the health check warns about it.
front-of-house.settings.retention.incide: How long after an incident is closed the people involved and what was written about it are kept. The incident's number, kind and dates are always kept. Shortening this deletes older details at the next daily run.
Keep incident details involving a child for
The same, when a child was involved. Insurers and safeguarding guidance usually ask for longer. Shortening this deletes older details at the next daily run.
front-of-house.retain.incident.staff: This person is named on an incident that is still open. Their erasure runs once the incident is closed.
front-of-house.retain.incident.person: You are named on an incident the theatre is still looking into. Your account will be erased once it is closed.
front-of-house.retain.incident: Kept as the theatre's safety record of an incident, for the period the theatre has set.
